mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, keywords, major, min_salary AS minSalary, work_experience AS workExperience, location, enabled, created_at AS createdAt FROM subscriptions WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, keywords, major, min_salary AS minSalary, work_experience AS workExperience, location, enabled, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM subscriptions WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscriptions (user_id, keywords, major, min_salary, work_experience, location, enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{keywords}, #{major}, #{minSalary}, #{workExperience}, #{location}, #{enabled})
mapper.update: UPDATE subscriptions SET keywords = #{keywords}, major = #{major}, min_salary = #{minSalary}, work_experience = #{workExperience}, location = #{location} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE subscriptions SET enabled = #{enabled} WHERE id = #{id}
